_doc: Feature flags (scripts/ops/feature_flags.gd). Overrides: user://feature_flags.json {"name": bool} (ignored when GRIDFALL_FLAGS_IGNORE_USER=1), then env GRIDFALL_FLAGS="overview=0,analytics=1". First-person features use their registry id from scripts/fp/fp_features.gd; FpMode skips a disabled one.

sim_perf.description: First-person feature: time-sliced sim ticks so growth ticks never freeze the street (slice F).

streetscape.description: First-person feature: street-level light profile, weather and street lights (slice G1).

render_opt.description: First-person feature: quality preset application, LOD ranges and far-building chunks (slice G2).

traffic.description: First-person feature: lane traffic, buses and walking residents (slice E).

interact.description: First-person feature: interaction with residents, buildings, posters and cars (slice A).

hud_widgets.description: First-person feature: minimap, full map, compass and waypoint widgets (slice B).

chat.description: First-person feature: city chat feed, talk dialog and /mayor decrees (slice C).

posters.description: First-person feature: campaign, newspaper, shop and notice posters (slice D).

audio.description: First-person feature: street sound: buses, positional emitters and ambience (slice I).

overview.description: First-person feature: Tab city overview to watch construction sites.

drive.description: First-person feature: get into parked or stopped cars with F and drive them.

phone.description: First-person feature: B opens the phone Build app, which places roads, zones and buildings for the mayor who owns the land.

activity.description: First-person feature: AI activity feed, decision beacons and map pings showing which mayor or agent decided what, on which model, from which source, and where; mayors take staggered turns through the day on foot. J cycles the feed, G routes to the newest decision.

crews.description: First-person feature: the player's two building crews. Phone orders are built in real time (2-5 minutes for a building) by crews you can watch on site, with a board and a HUD card counting down; later orders queue for a free crew.

gmi_live.description: Kill switch for live GMI Cloud calls. Off: every call uses the replay cache or heuristics, as with GRIDFALL_OFFLINE=1.

analytics.description: Local product analytics to user://ops/analytics.jsonl (also GRIDFALL_ANALYTICS=1). Nothing is sent anywhere.

error_tracking.description: Write contextual error records to user://ops/errors.jsonl (also GRIDFALL_ERROR_LOG=1). In-memory error counters are always on.

ops_alerts.description: Evaluate data/alert_rules.json and print OPS_ALERT lines. Player toasts additionally need GRIDFALL_OPS_ALERTS_UI=1.
